acceptanceCriteria: Failed receipt audit or refused/failed reimport makes qualification fail, even when store bytes remain unchanged.
A qualifying run requires the fixed Beamfall export, consistent/agreed audit, expected item/receipt counts and successful zero-write reimport.
Qualification binds clean immutable source; dirty worktree builds and overridden fixture digests are explicitly nonqualifying.
body: Observed in review of 3337f5f6db262a2e0f75b548814e7d06dbbcdd05..d8e32a6764f8d88280f383b219c0f3a174798726 (V1-0436), script/measure-import-cal018.sh:103-116. Both audit and reimport exit statuses are discarded via || true; the final guard only validates initial import and unchanged bytes. A failed audit and a read-only refused reimport can therefore lead to QUALIFYING PASS. Also lines 28 and 56-61/115 allow arbitrary EXPECT_SHA256 and dirty source while claiming the pinned workload/HEAD. Source inspection confirms these missing predicates; no pinned-export live qualification run. Installed Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.523. Retain full qualification stdout and negative fixtures as acceptance evidence.
title: CAL-V0-018 measurement can qualify failed audit/reimport or unpinned input
